name: Shirasaki Sumire
source:
A beautiful young student who transferred from Florence, Italy to Yuugo's school. With blonde hair, blue eyes, and a lovely figure to match her style she is always scouted as a model when out on the town.

She is Yuugo's first childhood friend. Born in the same hospital at the same time, they became friends through their parents. When young, they played together in a nearby park, took baths together and shared their first kiss with each other.

She's been separated from Yuugo due to moving to Italy because of her parents own reasons but returns to Japan to fulfill their promise to meet each other again. To make up for lost time, she wants to be with Yuugo for as long as possible and that means being with him every minute.

Full of the passion she's cultivated in Italy, she's very aggressive in approaching Yuugo which results in a lot of skinship.
